```{=html}

```

Where each sediment fraction was sampled: bulk (whole sample), sieved to <63 µm, and
sieved to <20 µm. A site can appear in more than one category. Choose a category in
the sidebar, or show all together.

{{< include _db-setup.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
L = require("https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js")

home_lat = 58
home_lng = 10
home_zoom = 4

CAT_COL = ({ bulk: "#4477AA", sieved63: "#EE6677", sieved20: "#CCBB44" })
CAT_LAB = ({ bulk: "Bulk", sieved63: "Sieved <63 um", sieved20: "Sieved <20 um" })

categories = [
  { key: "all",      label: "All" },
  { key: "bulk",     label: "Bulk" },
  { key: "sieved63", label: "Sieved <63 um" },
  { key: "sieved20", label: "Sieved <20 um" }
]

// one row per (site, category)
all_data = db.query(`
  SELECT DISTINCT si.latitude AS latitude, si.longitude AS longitude,
    CASE WHEN m.frac_class = 'bulk'   THEN 'bulk'
         WHEN m.sieve_um_std = 63     THEN 'sieved63'
         WHEN m.sieve_um_std = 20     THEN 'sieved20' END AS cat
  FROM measurement m
    JOIN subsample sub ON sub.subsample_id = m.subsample_id
    JOIN event e       ON e.event_id       = sub.event_id
    JOIN site si       ON si.site_id       = e.site_id
  WHERE (m.frac_class = 'bulk' OR m.sieve_um_std IN (63, 20))
    AND si.latitude IS NOT NULL AND si.longitude IS NOT NULL
`)
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: sidebar
viewof selected_cat = Inputs.select(categories, {
  label: "Category:", format: d => d.label, value: categories[0]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: fill

// draw bulk first, sieved on top so the rarer sieved points stay visible
draw_order = ["bulk", "sieved63", "sieved20"]
map_data = (selected_cat.key === "all"
    ? all_data
    : all_data.filter(d => d.cat === selected_cat.key))
  .filter(d => d.cat != null)
  .slice()
  .sort((a, b) => draw_order.indexOf(a.cat) - draw_order.indexOf(b.cat))

shown_cats = selected_cat.key === "all" ? draw_order : [selected_cat.key]

{
  const container = html`<div class="map-container"><div id="map"></div></div>`
  yield container

  if (!container._map) {
    const map = L.map(container.querySelector("#map"), { zoomControl: true })
      .setView([home_lat, home_lng], home_zoom)
    L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
      attribution: "© OpenStreetMap contributors"
    }).addTo(map)

    const HomeControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: "topleft" },
      onAdd(map) {
        const btn = L.DomUtil.create("a", "leaflet-home-button")
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa fa-expand" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
        btn.title = "Reset view"
        L.DomEvent.on(btn, "click", e => {
          L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(e); map.setView([home_lat, home_lng], home_zoom)
        })
        return btn
      }
    })
    new HomeControl().addTo(map)

    const LegendControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: "bottomright" },
      onAdd() { const d = L.DomUtil.create("div", "legend"); d.id = "map-legend"; return d }
    })
    new LegendControl().addTo(map)

    container._map = map
    container._markers = L.layerGroup().addTo(map)
  }

  const { _map: map, _markers: markers } = container
  const legendEl = map.getContainer().querySelector("#map-legend")
  if (legendEl) {
    legendEl.innerHTML = `<div class="legend-title">Sediment fraction</div>` +
      shown_cats.map(c =>
        `<div class="legend-row"><span class="legend-swatch" style="background:${CAT_COL[c]}"></span> ${CAT_LAB[c]}</div>`
      ).join("")
  }

  markers.clearLayers()
  for (const d of map_data) {
    const circle = L.circleMarker([d.latitude, d.longitude], {
      radius: 5, fillColor: CAT_COL[d.cat],
      color: "#333", weight: 0.6, opacity: 1, fillOpacity: 0.8
    })
    circle.bindTooltip(CAT_LAB[d.cat], { sticky: true })
    markers.addLayer(circle)
  }
}

md`**${selected_cat.label}** · **${map_data.length}** site-fraction points`
```
